title: TechFest Awards 2026 Celebrates Construction Tech Innovators
summary: The winners of the Construction News and New Civil Engineer TechFest Awards 2026 were announced at a London ceremony.

title: Microchip Introduces Automotive Ethernet TSN Switches
summary: Microchip is sampling the LAN9324x and LAN9322x automotive-qualified Ethernet TSN switch families for software-defined vehicles.

title: Next-Gen Bionic Hand Restores Sense of Touch
summary: A new prosthetic hand wired to forearm nerves allows an amputee to feel pressure and handle delicate objects.

title: UK Industry Briefed on £35bn Small Nuclear Reactor Plan
summary: Over 200 British companies attended an event to discuss roles in a proposed £35bn program building 14 small modular nuclear reactors.

title: DOE Backs $4B Power Grid Intertie Project
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy is supporting Grid United's $4 billion electric power line intertie project in Wyoming.

title: EU Regulations Introduce Safety Rules for Farm Robots
summary: New EU regulations are tightening safety and compliance requirements for farms deploying autonomous machinery and AI-powered robots.

title: FCC Approves SpaceX to Launch Orbiting Datacenters
summary: The FCC has granted SpaceX permission to launch a network of one million AI datacenters into orbit.

title: element14 Launches Rise of the Robots Design Challenge
summary: element14 launched a design challenge inviting engineers and makers to build innovative robotics projects using development hardware and motors.

title: FCC Approves SpaceX Orbital Data Center Constellation
summary: The FCC granted SpaceX the first US authorization to launch up to one million satellites for orbital data centers.

title: Scientists Discover Brine Pools Beneath Red Sea
summary: Scientists discovered rare underwater brine pools a mile beneath the Red Sea that are teeming with microbial life.

title: Northrop M2-F3 Lifting Body Flies in 1970
summary: NASA's experimental wingless M2-F3 lifting body aircraft made its first powered flight on November 25, 1970.

title: AI-Native Autoencoder Communications with Transfer Learning
summary: Researchers proposed a low-latency transfer-learning procedure for AI-native autoencoder communications to adapt to new channel conditions.

title: OneOcean Simulation Suite for Marine Robotics
summary: OneOcean is a data-grounded simulation suite and benchmark designed to evaluate marine robotics across various navigation and task scenarios.

title: Revising Navigation Authority under Unreliable VLM Evidence
summary: Researchers introduced a memory-update mechanism to address ambiguous vision-language model evidence for persistent robot semantic navigation.

title: Sliding-Window Detection of Hidden Regimes
summary: This paper analyzes sliding-window estimators and switch costs for hidden regime-switching processes under stochastic conditions.

title: SpaceX Approved to Deploy 1 Million Starmind Satellites
summary: The FCC has approved SpaceX to deploy one million Starmind AI data-center satellites in orbit.

title: Adaptive Control Barrier Functions for Nonlinear Systems
summary: An adaptive control barrier function framework was developed to enforce safety constraints on uncertain nonlinear singularly perturbed systems.

title: RePace Accelerates Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: RePace is an offline reasoning framework that determines how much to accelerate each part of a demonstration to build faster vision-language-action policies.

title: Offline Discounted Reinforcement Learning Under Entropic Risk
summary: Researchers introduce the ERM-VI-LCB model-based algorithm and derive sample complexity guarantees for offline reinforcement learning under recursive entropic risk measures.

title: Distance Properties of Huffman Sequences
summary: A new study reveals that pairwise distances of Huffman sequences are determined by ternary signed patterns and preserved by dihedral symmetries of the zeros.

title: Adaptive Reliability Reserves for Residential Battery Fleets
summary: Using a county-risk threshold instead of a fixed 20 percent battery reserve raises modeled backup coverage and annualized margins in residential battery simulations.

title: Device-Referred Channel Sounding with Commodity Wi-Fi
summary: Researchers outline five impairment corrections for commodity Wi-Fi receivers to accurately serve as device-referred channel sounders at 5 and 6 GHz.

title: Anytime-Valid Sequential Verification for Robot Navigation
summary: A sequential verification rule using Gaussian likelihood ratios significantly reduces robot sensor scan counts during navigation under perception uncertainty.

title: AutoRSP AI Agent for Radar Sensing Pipeline Design
summary: AutoRSP is an AI agent that automatically designs radar sensing pipelines using sub-agents and validation feedback from realistic simulation and edge execution.

title: Vision-Language Scene Graphs as Memory for Embodied QA
summary: Evaluating simulated multi-room scene-graph pipelines shows how targeted repairs improve answerability and recall for embodied question answering systems.

title: ELMO Emergent Representations in Imitation Learning
summary: ELMO is an end-to-end framework that jointly trains a planner and decoder to encode robot trajectories as grounded semantic codes representing behavioral intent.

title: NASA Deploys Aircraft for US Army Detonation Monitoring
summary: NASA is sending research aircraft and using satellites as the Army prepares to detonate degrading explosives in Iowa.

title: Study Links Drained Peatlands to Long-Term Warming
summary: A new study reveals that the long-term decomposition of drained bogs, fens, and swamps causes about three percent of human-caused climate warming.

title: Volcanic Eruptions Create New Beaches on Iwo Jima
summary: Satellites captured images of new land created by a volcanic eruption, extending the beaches of Iwo Jima.

title: Conductive Polymer Hair Dyes Turn Hair Into EEG Electrodes
summary: Researchers developed electrically conductive polymer hair dyes that function as gel-free EEG electrodes for brain monitoring.
